data.body: CHECKPOINT: Implementation complete. Added --commit-to-epic flag (orthogonal to --report). When set after report written, invokes bash .claude/scripts/dso ticket scratch set <test_epic_id> measurement:report <json> via commit_to_epic(). CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is pinned to the plugin dir containing this script (parent.parent of __file__) to ensure the correct ticket dispatcher is used regardless of caller env. Scratch CLI failure propagates as non-zero exit with clear stderr. Without --commit-to-epic flag, no scratch write. Test 15 verifies scratch file written; test 16 verifies no scratch write without flag. All 41 tests GREEN. ruff check passes.
